_comment: Reference seed for the import refusal path (e2e/tests/collections.spec.ts). Valid JSON, and deliberately NONE of the five supported API documents: no `openapi`/`swagger` version marker, no `paths`, no `info.schema`, no `log.entries`, no `_type: export`. Uploading it must yield 422 {code: 'invalid_spec'} whose `errors` list NAMES the formats that would be accepted. A malformed file would instead be refused as `parse_error` — a different, already-covered contract.
name: team-notes
endpoints: we keep a list here but this file is not an API specification
the importer must not guess its way into treating it as one
